name: Standalone Icon
description: Bare icon glyph, distinct from atom.icon-button (icbtn) which is clickable on its own. Used inside a btn's chld array alongside a lbl to build an icon+text button (e.g. "Add New Row"), not as a standalone interactive element.
sourceRefs: examples/purchase-order-fapo-fapi.md (_fapi-general-sect: tableAddRowBtnIcon inside the line-items and additional-amount 'Add New Row' buttons)
usageNote: Pair with atom.label inside a btn's chld array, e.g. btn.chld = [icon, lbl], both wrapped in a flex div, to build an icon+text button. See sections referencing 'tableAddRowBtn' in examples/purchase-order-fapo-fapi.md.
